lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme kàn zhè jiàn shì?
lines.english: What do you think about this matter?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我觉得不错。虽然有问题，但可以解决。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bùcuò. Suīrán yǒu wèntí, dàn kěyǐ jiějué.
lines.english: I think it's not bad. Although there are problems, they can be solved.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 我也同意。不过需要时间。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě tóngyì. Bùguò xūyào shíjiān.
lines.english: I agree too. But it needs time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 对。不能太着急。慢慢来比较好。
lines.pinyin: Duì. Bùnéng tài zháojí. Mànmàn lái bǐjiào hǎo.
lines.english: Right. Can't be too anxious. Taking it slow is better.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zuì zhòngyào shì shénme?
lines.english: What do you think is most important?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我认为沟通最重要。大家多谈谈。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi gōutōng zuì zhòngyào. Dàjiā duō tántan.
lines.english: I think communication is most important. Everyone should talk more.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Yǒu dàoli. Wǒ huì zhùyì de.
